sources.summary: More than 100 lenses inside Luke Jerram’s Pollenarium let visitors see the outside world as insects would From the outside, it looks a little like something out of the Teletubbies. In fact, the new installation by the Bristol artist Luke Jerram represents a grain of pollen, and the inside represents an insect’s compound eye. Continue reading...
